summary: The victim received a convincing physical letter impersonating Ledger that directed them to scan a QR code for a fake security update. After entering the twenty four word recovery phrase on the phishing website attackers recreated the wallet and stole the Bitcoin without needing the physical Ledger device.
user_mistake: Entered the wallet recovery phrase into a website reached through a QR code
prevention: Ignore recovery phrase requests received by mail or websites / Keep the recovery phrase offline and enter it only during wallet recovery on a trusted hardware wallet
